description.value: Medley's Italian & Grill is a community restaurant situated inside the DoubleTree by Hilton in North Vancouver, blending authentic Italian specialties with Canadian favourites and grill classics under a head chef with over 30 years of experience. Everything is freshly prepared daily, from house-made pasta sauces to signature desserts, with menus spanning breakfast, brunch, lunch, and dinner. Dedicated senior and kids menus round out a broad offering that makes this a welcoming stop for mixed-group touring parties.
